profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Handled many software projects with problem-solving and logical reasoning skills, collaborate with team for software design and development particularly in Java and JavaScript. Consist of full-stack software development industry experience with many new technologies like React (with other JavaScript frameworks like Node and Express), Spring Boot, AWS, Selenium, SQL, MongoDB and many more. Hands-on experience in Java object-oriented programming and able to deliver projects in that.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed full-stack application in Java using Spring Framework. Implement many Spring concepts like Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring AOP, and Spring IOC using Java Annotation. Collaborate with team for agile software development methodology using SCRUM.

projects.title: Netflix_Clone
projects.description: It is a personal project. used many advanced concepts of ReactJS and developed full-fledged React application. it is using React hooks, Router, CSS, HTML, and axios.

projects.title: Movie Prediction System
projects.description: Import data from BookMyShow.com using python library. Clean that data and remove the outliers. Train the model using the SciKit library on the sub part of data. integrate that model into one. perform a test on the model over 3500 records and achieve 95% accuracy.
